subject.title: feat(memory): graduate sessionMemory from experimental — solve the multi-session continuity problem

question: Should OpenClaw graduate session transcript indexing from `experimental.sessionMemory` to a stable supported contract, and if so should it remain explicit opt-in or become a new-install default?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally keep transcript indexing experimental and opt-in, while the requested default touches privacy, security policy, ranking/source semantics, QMD export, and upgrade expectations that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Experimental Until Criteria Land
options.body: Keep this issue open as the graduation tracker and require the linked source-policy, duplicate-indexing, ranking, privacy, QMD, and cost/documentation criteria before any default change.

options.title: Graduate Stable Opt-In First
options.body: Remove the experimental naming only after stable docs/tests/source labels are ready, but keep session transcript indexing explicitly opt-in while real-world safety data accumulates.

options.title: Default On For New Installs
options.body: Make transcript indexing part of new-install defaults with clear DM/group visibility, cost guidance, opt-out controls, and upgrade proof for existing users.

recommendation.title: Keep Experimental Until Criteria Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the graduation tracker and require the linked source-policy, duplicate-indexing, ranking, privacy, QMD, and cost/documentation criteria before any default change.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory/session configuration and reset-persistence work makes this the strongest available routing signal for the product-contract decision.
